audit_metadata.attachment_status: No job assets found in runtime; IaC.pdf not available for in-environment parsing

task_scope_validation.automation_mismatch: run_experiments.sh chain omits R1.2 in C2.3,R1.2,D2.2

issues.title: Broken import
issues.description: Imports extract_terraform_code from non-existent utils module.
issues.suggested_fix: Import from src.eval_utils or add local helper with correct module path.

issues.title: Non-isolated pass@k sampling
issues.description: Parallel samples run against shared infrastructure and VM names.
issues.impact: Race conditions and invalid pass@k reliability.
issues.suggested_fix: Sequential apply-mode sampling or per-sample namespacing/sandbox isolation.

issues.title: Artifact collisions
issues.description: Log/history dirs do not include sample number.
issues.suggested_fix: Include sample_num in artifact path.

issues.title: Stale post-state verification
issues.description: Post-check can reuse pre-check cache for up to 10s.
issues.suggested_fix: Add force_refresh for post-checks or disable cache in correctness checks.

issues.title: Chain definition mismatch
issues.description: Runs C2.3,D2.2; expected chain includes R1.2.
issues.suggested_fix: Change chain to C2.3,R1.2,D2.2.

issues.title: Model config mismatch
issues.description: Script references model keys absent from config.
issues.impact: Experiment runner fails for missing models.
issues.suggested_fix: Align script model list with config or add missing configs.

issues.title: Verdict fallback misclassification
issues.description: Fallback checks can classify incorrect as correct due suffix overlap.
issues.impact: Wrong judge verdicts in edge responses.
issues.suggested_fix: Use strict regex or check Incorrect before Correct.

issues.title: Invalid test command
issues.description: References tests/test_compliance.py which does not exist.
issues.suggested_fix: Update to tests/test_bug_fixes.py or correct test target.

issues.title: min/max VM count ignored
issues.description: Validator checks vm_count only; ignores min_vm_count/max_vm_count used by C1.1.
issues.impact: False positives for CREATE count constraints.
issues.suggested_fix: Support min/max bounds in CreateValidation.

issues.title: Forbidden update actions not blocked
issues.description: No explicit failure for create/delete/replace in UPDATE tasks.
issues.suggested_fix: Add forbidden action checks and target-specific validation.

issues.title: READ validation blind spot
issues.description: Only xenorchestra_vm changes are considered.
issues.impact: Non-VM resource mutations can slip through READ checks.
issues.suggested_fix: Inspect all plan resource changes for READ tasks.

issues.title: Plan-only may pass when spec extraction fails
issues.description: Spec skipped can still evaluate as successful in plan-only mode.
issues.impact: False pass in partial failure scenarios.
issues.suggested_fix: Fail evaluation or mark indeterminate when terraform show JSON fails.

issues.title: Placeholder key not rejected
issues.description: Unresolved ${OPENROUTER_API_KEY} can propagate as literal.
issues.suggested_fix: Reject unresolved placeholder strings before API call setup.

issues.title: meets_requirements not tied to spec pass
issues.description: meets_requirements mirrors execution_successful logic.
issues.suggested_fix: Derive from execution_successful AND spec_accuracy.passed (with explicit edge-case policy).

issues.title: Incomplete dependencies
issues.description: Several scripts use packages not listed in requirements.
issues.impact: Many tools fail on clean install.
issues.suggested_fix: Add missing dependencies or split core/optional extras requirements.

issues.title: Hardcoded Windows absolute paths
issues.description: Scripts are tied to c:\Users\... paths.
issues.impact: Non-portable execution and frequent FileNotFound failures.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace with CLI args + relative paths + env-driven defaults.

issues.title: Missing input guard
issues.description: No existence check before opening comparison dataset.
issues.suggested_fix: Validate path and print actionable error.

issues.title: Unguarded filesystem assumptions
issues.description: Opens files/list dirs without preflight checks.
issues.suggested_fix: Add exists checks and explicit diagnostics.

issues.title: Archive extraction and transport security risk
issues.description: Uses tar.extractall without traversal checks and HTTP METEOR URL.
issues.suggested_fix: Use safe extraction guard + HTTPS/checksum verification.

issues.title: Weak API error handling
issues.description: No timeout/status handling or retry logic.
issues.suggested_fix: Add timeout, raise_for_status, retries, structured failure returns.

issues.title: Potential division by zero
issues.description: Brevity penalty computes r/c without explicit c==0 guard.
issues.impact: Runtime error for empty candidate token lists.
issues.suggested_fix: Return 0.0 when candidate length is zero.

issues.title: Expected lockfile never generated
issues.description: Metrics script waits on lockfile that evaluator never creates.
issues.suggested_fix: Create/remove .evaluation_in_progress in evaluator lifecycle.

issues.title: Silent pass for unknown specs/categories
issues.description: Missing or unknown strategy currently returns passed=True.
issues.impact: Spec enforcement can be bypassed silently.
issues.suggested_fix: Return warning status or fail in strict mode.

issues.title: Truthiness bug
issues.description: Uses if expected instead of explicit None check.
issues.impact: Incorrect behavior when expected value is 0.
issues.suggested_fix: Use expected is not None.

issues.title: Prompt metadata mismatch
issues.description: Stores config.system_prompt but evaluator often uses baseline_system_prompt.
issues.suggested_fix: Use same prompt-resolution logic as src/eval_core.py.

final_status.benchmark_reliability: not production-grade until Critical and High issues are fixed
